description: This file contains the Register controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages user registration, including displaying the registration form and handling the form submission with validation, customer creation, and login logic.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class handling the registration process for customer accounts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the registration form, initializes data variables, loads necessary models and extensions, and renders the registration view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for customer registration, performs validations, creates customer record, logs in the customer if applicable, and redirects after successful registration.
